description: This file defines the interface for the end-of-speech (EOS) detection component in the xr-audio SDK. It includes enumerations for EOS events, type definitions for EOS objects, and function prototypes for creating, initializing, running, and destroying EOS sessions, as well as retrieving version info, signal levels, and SNR.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_version_t
methods.description: Retrieves detailed version information for the EOS component.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_object_create_t
methods.description: Creates an EOS object, optionally signal level only.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_init_t
methods.description: Initializes an EOS session with provided parameters.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_object_destroy_t
methods.description: Destroys an EOS object and releases resources.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_run_float_t
methods.description: Runs EOS detection on float PCM samples, returns EOS event.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_run_int16_t
methods.description: Runs EOS detection on 16-bit PCM samples, returns EOS event.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_state_set_speech_begin_t
methods.description: Informs EOS detector that speech has begun.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_state_set_speech_end_t
methods.description: Informs EOS detector that speech has ended.

methods.name: xraudio_eos_func_signal_level_get_t
methods.description: Retrieves current signal level in percent.
